{
 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "9dbd7ed4",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# 2D coarse graining of bedload transport"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "998d1035",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "In this example, we demonstrate how to use the `CoarseGraining` to perform coarse graining on a 2D bedload transport simulation with periodic boundaries, and plot the results.\n",
    "In order to do that, you can use the `compute_CG.ipynb` Jupyter notebook provided in the `examples/bedload_transport` directory. \n",
    "\n",
    "The files required for this example can be found in the `examples/bedload_transport` directory of the repository:\n",
    "\n",
    "- The DEM simualtion data files in the `examples/bedload_transport/DEM_data` directory\n",
    "- The configuration file `config.ini` in the `examples/bedload_transport` directory"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "6cab25d5",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Import packages"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "4ca4dd69",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "First, ensure you have the necessary libraries installed:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "4d9ff8fc",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Hello from pysammos\n",
      "Loading macroscopic_fields package...\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Loading data_read package...\n",
      "Loading particle_phase package...\n",
      "Loading spatial_weights package...\n",
      "Loading neighbour_search package...\n",
      "Loading grid_generation package...\n",
      "Loading data_handle package...\n",
      "Loading data_write package...\n",
      "Loading post_averaging package...\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "from pysammos.utils.config_loader import load_config\n",
    "from pysammos.coarse_graining import CoarseGraining\n",
    "from pysammos.data_write.h5.writer import H5XarrayManager\n",
    "from pysammos.post_averaging.profiles import VerticalIntegrator"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "28571097",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import pyvista as pv"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "525d3b7f",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Completing the Configuration file"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "6b8ce0ed",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Before running the coarse graining, ensure that the `config.ini` file is properly set up. The configuration file contains various sections, marked by headers in square brackets. \n",
    "\n",
    "The `paths` section specifies the input and output file paths."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "a8e835d4",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "```ini\n",
    "[paths]\n",
    "particles_path = ../data_examples/bedload_transport/DEM_data/DES_FB1_\n",
    "contacts_path = ../data_examples/bedload_transport/DEM_data/ENTIRE_DOMAIN_\n",
    "output_path = ./PysammosCG/\n",
    "```"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "b1b3b494",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "<div class=\"alert alert-warning\">\n",
    "\n",
    "**Re-running the coarse graining:** Pysammos writes its results to `output_path`. If you have already run the workflow and want to run it again with a different number of time steps, a different spatial scale (grid/kernel width) or different exported variables, either change `output_path` to a new folder name (e.g. `./PysammosCG_run2/`) or delete the previous results first.\n",
    "\n",
    "</div>"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "51c873da",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The `timesteps` section defines the time range and interval for the coarse graining process. `t0` is the starting timestep, `tf` is the ending timestep, and `dt` is the timestep interval. \n",
    "Note that the `t_pad` parameter is used to specify the number of zero-padding to be added to the `t0` and `tf` values when reading the DEM simulation data files. This is useful when the timestep numbers in the filenames have leading zeros."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "d92cae3a",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "```ini\n",
    "[timesteps]\n",
    "t0 = 150\n",
    "tf = 152\n",
    "dt = 1 \n",
    "t_pad = 4\n",
    "```"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "a8d70a38",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "\n",
    "The `smoothing_function` section defines the `type` of smoothing function to be used for coarse graining. In this case, we are using the Lucy function.\n",
    "Find the corresponding documentation in the page `kernels_module`."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "819eb7cf",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "```ini\n",
    "[smoothing_function]\n",
    "type = Lucy\n",
    "```"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "9db6509a",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The `flags` section defines the `partialignore` flag, which indicates whether to ignore particle phases during the coarse graining process. \n",
    "It will force the number phases to be one if it is set to True."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "604892d9",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "```ini\n",
    "[flags]\n",
    "partialignore = True\n",
    "```"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "a109bc9d",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The `key_mapping` section maps the DEM simulation data fields to the expected keys used in the coarse graining process."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "af01fb2f",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "```ini\n",
    "[key_mapping]\n",
    "Global_ID = Particle_ID\n",
    "Particle_Velocity = Velocity\n",
    "Particle_Diameter = Diameter\n",
    "Particle_Density = Density\n",
    "Particle_Volume = Volume\n",
    "Particle_Mass = Mass\n",
    "Particle_Radius = None\n",
    "Coordination_Number = None\n",
    "Particle_i_ID = Particle_ID_1\n",
    "Particle_j_ID = Particle_ID_2\n",
    "Force_ij = FORCE_CHAIN_FC\n",
    "Contact_ij = FORCE_CHAIN_CONTACT_POINT\n",
    "```"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "8df278d1",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The `DEM_software` section specifies the DEM software used for the simulation. In this case, it is set to `mfix`."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "98c31351",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "```ini\n",
    "[DEM_software]\n",
    "software = mfix\n",
    "```"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "3fe7d338",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The `grid_info` section specifies the grid parameters for the coarse graining process, including the grid dimensions, axes, and boundaries. \n",
    "\n",
    "- The `grid_dimension` is set to '2' for a 2D simulation.\n",
    "- The `grid_axes` are set to '`xy`', indicating that the coarse graining will be performed in the x and y directions.\n",
    "- The `automatic_grid` is set to `False`, allowing for manual specification of grid boundaries.\n",
    "- The `x_min`, `x_max`, `y_min`, and `y_max` parameters define the spatial extent of the grid.\n",
    "- The `z_transect` is set to '0.0', indicating that the coarse graining will be performed at this z-level.\n",
    "- The `x_axis_periodic` is set to '`True`', indicating that the x-axis is periodic, while the y and z axes are non-periodic.\n",
    "\n",
    "Find the corresponding documentation in the following page: `grid_generation`."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "08dc2c95",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "```ini\n",
    "[grid_info]\n",
    "grid_dimension = 2\n",
    "grid_axes = xy\n",
    "automatic_grid = False\n",
    "x_min = 0.00105\n",
    "x_max = 0.5\n",
    "y_min = 0.001\n",
    "y_max = 0.24\n",
    "z_min = None\n",
    "z_max = None\n",
    "x_transect = None\n",
    "y_transect = None\n",
    "z_transect = 0.0\n",
    "x_axis_periodic = True\n",
    "y_axis_periodic = False\n",
    "z_axis_periodic = False\n",
    "```"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "79b3c36b",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The `simulation_box` section specifies the limits of the DEM simulation box, required on every periodic axis in `[grid_info]`"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "237b9e0d",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "```ini\n",
    "[simulation_box]\n",
    "x_range = 0, 0.5\n",
    "y_range = None\n",
    "z_range = None\n",
    "```"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "fb015fa7",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The `fields_to_export` section specifies which coarse-grained fields to export. "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "0b0be3cd",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "```ini\n",
    "[fields_to_export]\n",
    "volume_fraction = True\n",
    "density_particle = False\n",
    "density_mixture = True\n",
    "momentum_density = False\n",
    "velocity = True\n",
    "velocity_gradient = True\n",
    "kinetic_tensor = False\n",
    "contact_tensor = False\n",
    "total_stress_tensor = True\n",
    "pressure = True\n",
    "granular_temperature = True\n",
    "granular_temperature_slices = True\n",
    "fabric_tensor = True\n",
    "inertial_number = True\n",
    "coordination_number = False\n",
    "d43 = False\n",
    "d32 = False\n",
    "frictional_coefficient = True\n",
    "shear_rate_tensor = False\n",
    "```"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "dbd96e55",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The `output_options` section defines the output formats for the coarse-grained data, including `vkthdf` and `h5` formats.\n",
    "Additionally, `time_average` defines whether time-averaged quantities will be exported into seperate files."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "fb593446",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "```ini\n",
    "[output_options]\n",
    "vkthdf_output = True\n",
    "h5_output = False\n",
    "time_average = True\n",
    "```"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "5b930e97",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Run the coarse graining"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "90fccee8",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### 1) Initialise the CoarseGraining class"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "bc30620f",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We should initialize the configuration and the coarse graining object. You can either do it through the configuration file and the `load_config` function, \n",
    "or you can directly input the parameters (that you have entered in the configuration file) into the `CoarseGraining` class arguments."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "id": "62499fd1",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Output path already exists: ./PysammosCG/\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Load the configuration from the ini file\n",
    "cfg = load_config(\"./config.ini\")  \n",
    "\n",
    "# Initialize the CoarseGraining class with the loaded configuration\n",
    "CG = CoarseGraining(\n",
    "    particle_path=cfg[\"particle_path\"],\n",
    "    contacts_path=cfg[\"contacts_path\"],\n",
    "    output_path=cfg[\"output_path\"],\n",
    "    start_timestep=cfg[\"start_timestep\"],\n",
    "    end_timestep=cfg[\"end_timestep\"],\n",
    "    dt_time_step=cfg[\"dt_time_step\"],\n",
    "    t_pad=cfg[\"t_pad\"],\n",
    "    DEM_keymap=cfg[\"DEM_keymap\"],\n",
    "    DEM_software=cfg[\"DEM_software\"],\n",
    "    grid_info=cfg[\"grid_info\"],\n",
    "    weight_function=cfg[\"weight_function\"],\n",
    "    fields_to_export=cfg[\"fields_to_export\"],\n",
    "    simulation_box=cfg[\"simulation_box\"],\n",
    "    time_average=cfg[\"time_average\"],\n",
    "    ignore_phases=cfg[\"ignore_phases\"],\n",
    "    h5_output=cfg[\"h5_output\"],\n",
    "    vkthdf_output=cfg[\"vkthdf_output\"],\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "c2478c30",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "If you use the `load_config` to load the configuration file entries, you can input the `CoarseGraining` arguments directly: "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "id": "2d3ce807",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Output path already exists: ./PysammosCG/\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "cfg = load_config(\"config.ini\")  \n",
    "CG = CoarseGraining(**cfg)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "c1ba89cc",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### 2) Run the coarse-graining workflow"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "80482d4c",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "#### Option A: using a single command"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "47623c67",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [

  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "c6cd724a",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "#### Option B: running each step separately "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "9d7f9c41",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "1. Load the size-relevant particle data for the first time step"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "id": "84dc6ac3",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Sampling data for the first time step to obtain particle properties and bounds ... \n",
      "XML-based PolyData detected.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "Bounds_t0, Diameter_t0, Density_t0, Mass_t0, GlobalID_t0 = CG.data_sampling()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "338bd569",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "2. Calculate the particle size range"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "id": "d9410d4b",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      ">> Particle size statistics: \n",
      "       d43:  0.01651367411185649\n",
      "       dmax:  0.019993\n",
      "       d50:  0.016306963\n",
      "       d32:  0.016109877148148044\n",
      "       drms:  0.015422490500786803\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "\n",
    "CG.get_particle_size_statistics(Diameter_t0, Mass_t0)\n",
    "print(\">> Particle size statistics: \") \n",
    "print(\"       d43: \", CG.d43)\n",
    "print(\"       dmax: \", CG.dmax)\n",
    "print(\"       d50: \", CG.d50)\n",
    "print(\"       d32: \", CG.d32)\n",
    "print(\"       drms: \", CG.drms)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "8853dcbd",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "3. Get the phases"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 11,
   "id": "4cdd254c",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Ignoring phases. Using mean density and d50 as phase.\n",

      "       Diameters:  [0.01610988]\n",
      "       Densities:  [2700.]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "CG.get_particle_phases(Diameter_t0, Density_t0, GlobalID_t0, 8)\n",
    "print(\">> Phases: \")\n",
    "print(\"       Diameters: \", CG.phases[:,0])\n",
    "print(\"       Densities: \", CG.phases[:,1])"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "965535f2",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "4. Calculate the CG grid spacing"

  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",

   "id": "f2d14442",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",

      "       w: 0.012082407861111033\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "CG.set_resolution(CG.d32) # here you can input different number, to make w and c bigger or smaller \n",
    "print(\">> Coarse Graining resolution: \")\n",
    "print(\"       c:\", CG.c)\n",
    "print(\"       w:\", CG.w)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "af76dc98",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "5. Generate the CG grid"

      "       Nodes:  [43 21  1]\n",

     ]
    }

   "source": [
    "CG.generate_grid()\n",
    "print(\">> Grid: \")\n",
    "print(\"       Grid Points: \", CG.GridPoints.shape, \"First Point: \", CG.GridPoints[0])\n",
    "print(\"       Nodes: \", CG.Nodes)\n",
    "print(\"       Spacing: \", CG.Spacing)"
   ]
  },

  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "f62526c6",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Plotting the Results in Python"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "20c8fb7e",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "After running the above code, the coarse-grained fields will be saved in the specified output directory.\n",
    "To visualize the results from the `.h5` files, you can use the provided Jupyter notebook `visualization_bedload_transport.ipynb` in the same directory."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "de43741a",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### 1. Initialize the H5XarrayManager to read the coarse-grained data"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 15,

      "Processing key: total_stress_tensor_xyz\n",
      "Processing key: total_stress_tensor_xyz_dev\n",
      "Processing key: total_stress_tensor_xyz_dev_mag\n",
      "Processing key: total_stress_tensor_xyz_mag\n",
      "Processing key: velocity\n",
      "Processing key: velocity_gradient\n",
      "Processing key: volume_fraction\n",

      "Processing key: granular_temperature_LAMMPS\n",

   ],
   "source": [
    "# gridded data\n",
    "manager = H5XarrayManager(\"./PysammosCG/CG_Lucy_Monodisperse.h5\")\n",
    "bedload_CG = manager.h5_to_xarray()\n",
    "\n",
    "# time-averaged gridded data\n",
    "manager_avg = H5XarrayManager(\"./PysammosCG/CG_Lucy_Monodisperse_time_averaged.h5\")\n",
    "bedload_CG_avg = manager_avg.h5_to_xarray()\n",
    "\n",
    "# sliced granular temperature data\n",
    "manager_gt = H5XarrayManager(\"./PysammosCG/CG_GranularTemperature_slices.h5\")\n",
    "slices_gt = manager_gt.h5_to_xarray()\n",
    "\n",
    "# sliced granular temperature time averaged \n",
    "manager_gt_avg = H5XarrayManager(\"./PysammosCG/CG_GranularTemperature_slices_time_averaged.h5\")\n",
    "slices_gt_avg = manager_gt_avg.h5_to_xarray()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "450f6933",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### 2. Plotting the mixture density field at a specific time step"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 16,
   "id": "68a53dff",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1000x500 with 2 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Create figure and axis\n",
    "fig = plt.figure(figsize=(10,5))\n",
    "ax = fig.add_subplot(111)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Plot DEM particle positions \n",
    "bedload_DEM = pv.read('../data_examples/bedload_transport/DEM_data/DES_FB1_0150.vtp')\n",
    "bedload_particles = bedload_DEM.points\n",
    "x_particle = bedload_particles[:, 0]; y_particle = bedload_particles[:, 1]\n",
    "ax.scatter(x_particle, y_particle, s=10, c='k', alpha=1, label='Particle Positions', zorder=3)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Plot the CG data\n",
    "x = np.asarray(bedload_CG.positions[:, 0]) \n",
    "y = np.asarray(bedload_CG.positions[:, 1])\n",
    "z = np.asarray(bedload_CG.positions[:, 2])\n",
    "var = np.asarray(bedload_CG.density_mixture.values[0, :])\n",
    "sc = ax.scatter(x, y, s=65, c=var, \n",
    "                cmap='viridis', alpha=0.6, label='CG Density', \n",
    "                zorder=1, marker='s')\n",
    "\n",
    "# Add colorbar and labels\n",
    "plt.colorbar(sc, ax=ax, label='Density')\n",
    "ax.set_xlabel('X Position')\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel('Y Position')\n",
    "ax.set_title(' Coarse-Grained Mixture Density')\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "09ca63f6",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### 3. Plotting the granular temperature field at a specific time step"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "8e3fb51e",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The vertical profiles of the coarse-grained fields can be plotted using the following code, which uses the subpackage `vertical_profiles`. Below we plot the profile of density_mixture of the first time step, after performing vertical intergration to obtain vertical profiles."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 17,
   "id": "aa138680",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Starting integration along profile dimension: y\n",
      "Completed integration along profile dimension: y\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 640x480 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Perform vertical integration\n",
    "VI = VerticalIntegrator(bedload_CG, 'y')\n",
    "vertical_ds_general = VI.integration()\n",
    "\n",
    "# plot the profile of density_mixture of the first time step\n",
    "vertical_ds_general['density_mixture'].isel(time=0).plot.line(x='y', label='Density Mixture General')\n",
    "plt.xlabel('y coordinate')\n",
    "plt.ylabel('Integrated Density Mixture')\n",
    "plt.title('Vertical Profile of Integrated Density Mixture at First Time Step')\n",
    "plt.legend()\n",
    "plt.grid()\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "da155aca",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### 4. Plotting the granular temperature slices calculated with other methods"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "955040e8",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Pysammos provides the granular temperature slices along specified transects using other methods. See the documentation for more details: check the page `gran_temp_slices`."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 18,
   "id": "eb948ffc",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 800x500 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# plot first time step vertical profile comparing Kamrin and LAMMPS\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8,5))\n",
    "ax.plot(slices_gt.granular_temperature_Kamrin[0,:,0], slices_gt.positions[:, 1], label='Granular Temperature Kamrin', color='blue')\n",
    "ax.plot(slices_gt.granular_temperature_LAMMPS[0,:,0], slices_gt.positions[:, 1], label='Granular Temperature LAMMPS', color='orange')\n",
    "ax.set_xlabel('Granular Temperature')\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel('Y Position')\n",
    "ax.set_title('Granular Temperature Vertical Profile at z=0, Timestep 0')\n",
    "#gridlines\n",
    "ax.grid(visible=True, which='both', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5)\n",
    "# log scale x axis\n",
    "ax.set_xscale('log')\n",
    "ax.legend()\n",
    "plt.show()  "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "94de8dbc",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### 5. Plotting time-averaged data"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "190e4758",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Pysammos also calculates time-averaged quantities, below we show how to visualise them:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 19,
   "id": "49a07f61",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 800x500 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8,5))\n",
    "ax.plot(slices_gt_avg.granular_temperature_Kamrin[0,:,0], slices_gt_avg.positions[:, 1], color=\"blue\")\n",
    "ax.set_xlabel('X Position')\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel('Granular Temperature Kamrin')\n",
    "ax.set_title('Time-Averaged Granular Temperature Kamrin Profile')\n",
    "ax.grid(visible=True, which='both', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5)\n",
    "ax.set_xscale('log')\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "2973b1a2",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Note that time averaging of non-linear fields, e.g. inertial number, is constructred from the time-averaged quantities, instead of taking the time series average of the non-linear field of interest. The difference between these two calculations is shown below: "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 20,
   "id": "e8c85173",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 800x500 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Calculate time-averaged and time series averaged inertial numbers\n",
    "I_tav = bedload_CG_avg.inertial_number_Sxy_Pxy_d32[0,:]\n",
    "I_ts_averaged = bedload_CG.inertial_number_Sxy_Pxy_d32.mean(dim='time')\n",
    "\n",
    "# plot difference between time-averaged inertial number and time series averaged inertial number\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8,5))\n",
    "ax.scatter(I_tav, bedload_CG_avg.positions[:, 1], label='Time-Averaged Inertial Number [correct]', color='blue')\n",
    "ax.scatter(I_ts_averaged,  bedload_CG_avg.positions[:, 1], label='Time Series Averaged Inertial Number [incorrect]', color='orange')\n",
    "ax.set_xlabel('Inertial Number')\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel('Y Position')\n",
    "ax.set_title('Comparison of Time-Averaged Inertial Number Profiles')\n",
    "#gridlines\n",
